layouts.overall: A4 Print-first layout simulated on web. High-density Grid for Data but with generous internal padding for breathing room. Strict hierarchy.
layouts.cover_page: Full-bleed hero image with bg-black/40 overlay, massive H1 heading ('SustainRepo ESG Executive Report'), prominent logo placeholder, and report period. High contrast. Grid Tetris style.
layouts.data_sections: Mode B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). Flat solid surfaces with max 8px border-radius and 1px sharp border. No glassmorphism.
layouts.page_breaks: Structure the UI into clear, distinct sections (Cover, Exec Summary, Emissions, Operations, Suppliers) to simulate PDF pages.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border. Sharp, clean 'Swiss' technical lines separating data points.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal/None. Use flat solid borders for print clarity.
visual_enhancers.charts: Shadcn Recharts with organic palette (Forest Green, Moss, Ochre, Terracotta). Ensure labels are legible without hover (print safe).
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (regular weight) for clear, executive dashboard feel.

components.kpi_cards: Flat background (surface), 1px border, high contrast value text, explicit trend indicator (up/down arrow with +X% or -X%).
components.tables: Dense, clean padding, prominent header. Use left-alignment for text, right-alignment for numbers. Use Shadcn Table.
components.email_summary: Render a visual representation of the scheduled email. CRITICAL: REMOVE 'Source Records Processed'. Must be concise and fact-based.
components.target_tracking: Use Shadcn Progress bars with sharp edges, contrasting fill (Primary or Accent depending on status).

cover_hero.description: Aerial view of a lush green sustainable forest canopy. Use as Cover Page background with bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast.

energy_section.description: Clean modern wind turbines. Use as an accent banner for the Energy/Emissions data section.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the UI that generates a multi-section executive PDF MIS report for SustainRepo ESG.
Use light theme exclusively as this is a PDF-first report.

Include the following sections: 'Cover Page', 'Executive KPI Comparisons', 'Emissions & Resources' (tCO2e, energy/water/waste), 'Operations & Safety' (incidents, LTIFR, account payable days), and 'Supplier Performance' (assessment scores per supplier).
In the Email notification summary component (if visually represented), REMOVE 'Source Records Processed' per user request. Keep it concise with factual insights.
Update tailwind.config.js to include the new colors and fonts.

Update index.css with the font imports (@import url('https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700&display=swap'); and Google Fonts IBM Plex Sans) and set the base font family to IBM Plex Sans, headings to Cabinet Grotesk.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn UI components.
Use Recharts for monthly trend (tCO2e), facility breakdowns, and incident splits. Disable tooltip-reliance for critical data so it's visible in a static PDF print.
Structure the layout as a scrollable container with internal 'page' sections imitating an A4 aspect ratio where possible.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use grid-based optical alignments.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. No generic gradients.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions specifically to interactive elements.
Do NOT center align the app container `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Do not use AI assistant emojis.
